JHU ICBM-DTI-81 White Matter Labels

Source: R/data.R
jhu_labels.Rd

ICBM-DTI-81 white matter labels atlas with 48 regions derived from a probabilistic atlas of 81 normal subjects. Contains 3D mesh geometry for ggseg3d::ggseg3d().

Usage

jhu_labels()

Value

A ggseg.formats::ggseg_atlas object (subcortical).

References

Mori S, et al. (2005). MRI Atlas of Human White Matter. Elsevier. ISBN: 978-0444517418

Wakana S, et al. (2007). Reproducibility of quantitative tractography methods applied to cerebral white matter. NeuroImage, 36(3):630-644. doi:10.1016/j.neuroimage.2007.02.049

See also

Other ggseg_atlases: icbm(), jhu_tracts()

Other tract_atlases: icbm(), jhu_tracts()

Examples

jhu_labels()
#> 
#> ── jhu_labels ggseg atlas ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> Type: subcortical
#> Regions: 48
#> Hemispheres: NA
#> Views: axial_2, axial_3, axial_4, axial_5, coronal_1, coronal_2, coronal_3,
#> coronal_4, sagittal, axial_1

#> Rendering: ✔ ggseg
